contentPolicy.description: Content Guard Service (CGS) safety policy ('redline', 'general', 'family', or 'faceSwapRedline'). The first three set CGS params.run_usc.nsfw_mode directly; 'faceSwapRedline' uses nsfw_mode='redline' and custom_block_rule_codes=['FS-CHILD-ADULT'] to enable face-swap checks alongside redline safety. Opts any model into CGS: the model-configured workflow is used when present, otherwise the configured default ('prompt_forge'). An explicit policy enforces every CGS block; CGS errors fail open. CGS screens prompts, input images and generated images; video is not screened. Not supported for upsampling or batch requests. Available to user- and service-token callers. Omission preserves existing behavior.
